name: Vision & Opportunity (SDLC Phase 0)
description: Establishing the foundational product vision and market opportunity before any solution work begins — aka North Star, Product Strategy, Problem Framing, Opportunity Mapping, Lean Inception, 0→1.
owner: SDLC Templates — NoteShare Pro Reference Library

capabilities.name: Vision & Opportunity Framing
capabilities.description: Establishes the product vision, business model, and market opportunity that justifies building the product at all.

checklists.name: Vision & Opportunity (SDLC Phase 0) Checklist
checklists.description: Comprehensive validation checklist for product vision, market opportunity framing, and strategic alignment.

items.statement: The stated vision and opportunity sizing are grounded in real market/user evidence, not assertion alone.
Target user persona, core pain points, and Jobs-to-be-Done (JTBD) are explicitly identified with documented user quotes or research data.
TAM (Total Addressable Market), SAM (Serviceable Addressable Market), and SOM (Serviceable Obtainable Market) have documented calculation models.
Competitive teardown identifies at least 3 direct or indirect alternatives and defines proposed moat/differentiator.
Lean Business Model Canvas addresses value proposition, customer channels, revenue model, cost structure, and unfair advantage.
Initial key assumptions and top critical risks (value, usability, feasibility, business viability) are logged with validation hypotheses.
Success metrics and draft OKRs define clear leading indicators and measurable business outcomes.
Executive and key stakeholder alignment has been achieved on project scope, strategic intent, and seed funding boundary.

reviewGates.name: Product Vision One-Pager Review
reviewGates.statement: The Product Vision One-Pager has been reviewed and accepted as clear, strategically aligned, and compelling.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the Product Vision One-Pager clearly articulate the North Star, problem framing, and strategic intent?

reviewGates.name: Lean Canvas & Viability Review
reviewGates.statement: The Lean Business Model Canvas has been evaluated for financial, strategic, and operational viability.
reviewGates.prompt: Is the business model canvas realistic, supported by assumptions, and financially viable?

obligationDefinitions.title: Validate core vision assumptions before funding downstream phases
obligationDefinitions.description: The market/opportunity assumptions underlying the Product Vision One-Pager and Lean Canvas must be tracked and revisited against real discovery/beta findings, not treated as fixed once later phases are commissioned on top of them.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: The assumption log is checked against discovery/beta findings at each downstream phase gate; discrepancies are recorded as Knowledge, not silently dropped.

requiredEvidence.title: Assumption log review
requiredEvidence.description: A recorded review of the vision's stated assumptions against evidence gathered in later phases.
requiredEvidence.collectionMethod: Manual review recorded at Discovery/Beta checkpoints.

obligationDefinitions.prompt: Do the vision's core market/opportunity assumptions still hold given the evidence gathered since?
obligationDefinitions.assurance: Reviewed by Product leadership at each downstream phase gate.
